programDescription: You learn a variety of applications to put computer science into real life applications. You learn the coding language python(functions, classes, methods, lists, etc) and advanced data structuring in python, then implement them.
admissionCoursesNeeded: You must take the following: Grade 12 English | Minimum of 70% Advanced Functions Calculus
academicCostDetails: Books and other supplies can vary in cost but the range of that cost is around $1,000 to $2,000
livingCostDetails: If you want to live on campus, the cost is around $8,123 to $17,163
interestingFacts: 92% of students that take this computer science course are usually employed after 2 years of taking this course and graduation. Like all computer science courses, this course is extremely competitive to get into. With requirements of low 90s to high 90s average.  University of Toronto’s computer science programs are ranked one of the best in the world.
